listNote: The official 55-trophy PS5 list. Names, descriptions and grades are reproduced exactly as published; guides, kinds, counters and missable flags are this tracker's own work.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list — Exophase · PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: The platinum is the finish line rather than a task: it unlocks by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Work the roadmap stages in order, keep an eye on the missable watch flags while you play the story, and this will be the last trophy to pop.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission that sets Lucia and Jason's story in motion. The prologue is a one-time ride, so simply play through it and the trophy is yours before the map even opens.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission filed under Chapter 1. Chapters advance automatically as you clear the marked main jobs, so follow the story markers and the chapter will close itself out.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the main story. Keep following the primary mission markers and save the side content for later if you want a clean run to the credits first.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. By now both protagonists' strands are fully open, so if one marker stalls, switch characters and play the other thread until the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the penultimate story chapter. Stock up on armour and snacks before the closing stretch, because the late missions tend to chain together with few quiet breaks.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. In a two-protagonist story the ending can hinge on late choices, so keep a manual save from the start of the final chapter; if a choice ever locks you out of an ending, reload that save instead of restarting the whole game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run. It is a one-time story beat, so it unlocks simply by playing the campaign through in order.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a set-piece story mission. Play the campaign in order and it arrives as part of the plot; any prep choices may change the route you take, but not the trophy at the end of it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Story missions are one-time events, so this lands naturally as you advance the plot from marker to marker.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Keep progressing the main job markers and the trophy lands as the mission wraps up.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a story mission built around the airport authority. It is a fixed chapter beat, so playing the story in order is all it takes.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a scripted story operation. Finish it as part of the campaign and the trophy follows automatically.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the stats page. That means the full story, every stranger strand, all the collectible sets and the bulk of the activity lists, so use this tracker's per-grade and per-kind counts to hunt down whatever slice of percentage is still missing.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunt moves — jumps, flips and near-miss chains all feed the total. The stunt-rich hills and the airport ramps are reliable farming spots; pick a jump you like, repeat it, and let the counter climb.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once: races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone races, challenges and hunting cover the list. One attempt each is enough, so tour the map icons and sample everything Leonida offers.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each weapon's recoil pattern, retry freely, and leave the strictest accuracy challenges until the handling feels natural in your hands.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Finishing is not enough — you need the win — so take a practice run to learn each course's racing line before you chase the trophy run.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeating the same event does not add to the tally. Work through the race icons on the map one by one and stick to a vehicle class you are comfortable with.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Upgrade your rod and bait as the shops allow, pick a calm spot, and his score becomes very beatable once your gear reaches the mid tier.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game from start to finish. Pick the shortest cabinet you can find in an arcade or bar, play it through, and the trophy pops at the results screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Stranger strands can dry up if you rush past their triggers, so clear Andy's markers whenever they appear on the map instead of saving them all for the endgame.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission to close out his strand. Work his jobs as they appear on the map rather than stockpiling them, and his finale will arrive in good time.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. His strand is one of the shorter ones, so check the map for his marker after each story chapter and ride it out to the end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each strand is a short chain for one character — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret among them — so finish chains one at a time rather than starting them all at once.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. His supply-run strand unlocks in stages, so return to his marker whenever a fresh one appears and the finale will surface.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission to finish his strand. Clear his jobs as they appear on the map and the closing marker arrives once the chain is done.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots scattered across Leonida. They sit in scenic, quiet places — beaches, rooftops and hilltops — so treat the hunt as a sightseeing tour and tick each one off as you find it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. The wording says unique for a reason — there is one quarry and one chance at it — so save your game before you take the shot and make it count.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. Cards hide in shops, bars and landmarks all over the state; finish the shortest sets first and sweep each district methodically so none slip past.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations. It is a quick interaction, so build it into your routine: every new shop, bar or landmark you visit, do it once and move on.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the challenge board. Mix short driving, combat and exploration challenges, and keep this tracker open to watch how many remain.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a four-star wanted level, then lose the heat and escape. Commit something loud together, break line of sight, and hide out until the stars drain away completely.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level alive the whole time. Plan a tight route of nearby stores, move fast between them, and never let the stars fully clear mid-run.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting in or registering them as you find them. Busy districts and rich neighbourhoods spawn the widest variety, so a slow cruise through each new area fills the log quickly.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single Combat Focus activation. Line up a crowded firefight first, trigger Focus while the group is bunched together, and work from the closest target outward.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, get out of the airport in a way the schedule never intended. It reads like a one-off scene, so if a story visit puts you there, experiment with the exits before you leave.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks — when they roll out against you. Heavy ordnance or a bold hijack both work; survive the encounter and the trophy is yours. Expect them at maximum heat or around military ground.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, enter quietly, keep your weapon holstered until the till is open, and slip away before an alarm turns into a sighting.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five Bank Vaults and escape cleanly each time. Vault jobs are the heavy end of the robbery ladder, so bring your partner, plan the exit route in advance, and lose the heat before you celebrate.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush it on a quiet stretch of road, crack it open fast, grab the cash and break line of sight before the response arrives.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, and the last few percent usually hide out in the Keys and the rural north, so finish with a full coastal loop to sweep up the stragglers.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Every gang holds turf somewhere in the state; hit one operation per gang and tick them off here as you go.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a drink and take in the view — quite possibly the simplest trophy on the whole list.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into one of the display cars and drive it straight through the glass frontage — subtlety is not on the menu for this one.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit the alley, play the bowling activity there, and complete the follow-through the description hints at — bring your partner for the full reference.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — the description is coy, so expect a co-op flavoured scene with your partner. Keep doing partner activities together and it should surface; if a crowd or camera moment appears, play along with the prompt.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The game logs the choices you make, for better or worse, and the count runs up to 500. You will rack these up naturally by playing both characters' stories and making every decision the game offers instead of letting prompts time out.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail at something, then succeed on the retry. If it has not popped naturally, deliberately botch a quick event or challenge and immediately clear it on the second attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — what the hell just happened, indeed. Leonida hides weird encounters in its swamps and skies, so explore off the beaten path after dark and investigate anything that looks out of place.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect. Low speed and a crowded pavement make this far easier than it sounds — cruise slowly and time the swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, so route them through your laundering contacts instead of spending them raw, and use the counter here to watch the total climb.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, vehicle work and property spending all add up, so do not hoard your cash — this usually completes on its own during a full platinum run.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties. Save up as you play, then sweep the property listings — the garages double as extra vehicle storage, so they are worth owning even without a trophy attached.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you find a keeper on the street, register it before you move on and the tally fills up quickly.
trophies.name: On the Spot
